summary: Collect the terms used in team dispatches and extract them into the glossary.
statement: Collect terms from team dispatches, extract to glossary.
brief: Given in chat while T019 (run 1 of the corpus migration) was in flight. The constitution (line 109) keeps a glossary of agreed terms and ids in the base: a term is offered with a - bullet and a one-line description, and the commander flips it to + if approved. No glossary exists yet; the dispatch records at records/dispatch/ and the crew and roster files hold the terms the cockpit has been using.
